task_title: Serve incidents and incident actions from the incidents service

acceptance_criteria.1_real_service_reads: BFF incident list, detail, and incident part of the risk alert builder read from the real incidents service (services/incidents/main.py via DomainIncidentPort) and never from an in-memory overlay.
acceptance_criteria.2_real_service_actions: resolve, start-mitigation, escalate, and acknowledge on an incident reach POST /api/incidents/{id}/status on the incidents service through every existing entry point (REST incident routes, IncidentAction, and RiskAlertAction domain commands), and BFF returns the authoritative status read back from it.
acceptance_criteria.3_durable_owner_and_fail_closed: Alert acknowledgement is persisted by the incidents service as durable owner and survives BFF restart; alerts without a durable owner report acknowledgement as unavailable with HTTP 422 (durable_owner_unavailable).
acceptance_criteria.4_memory_overlays_deleted: Hard-coded 202 accepted responses, in-memory incident overlay (_incident_overlay), _ACKNOWLEDGED_ALERTS, and fabricated incident adapter results (hard-coded alert-001/inc-001) are completely deleted.
acceptance_criteria.5_fail_closed_on_service_unavailable: When the incidents service is unavailable, BFF reports unavailable (HTTP 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE for detail/actions; status unavailable on surfaces) instead of returning an empty or fabricated list.
acceptance_criteria.6_mounted_tests: Mounted tests in test_incidents_real_source.py cover every entry point against a stubbed incidents service, in addition to full test suites passing across existing incident test files.
